subject: P0 - Quasar Health: token queue spiral; request for orchestrated region taper & exec sign-off
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@quasarhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@quasarhealth.com>, sre-pager@quasarhealth.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Hi Lauren,

We started seeing token queue growth on our production traffic to your US-WEST endpoint at ~08:30 PT. Latency has climbed from ~120ms to 850-1200ms and 5xx has trended up to ~6% in the last 20 minutes. This is impacting our real-time triage workflows and several customer sessions are timing out.

Attached is the Grafana snapshot and a small CSV extract. Our SREs have restarted a few routers but the queue keeps rebuilding — appears to be a backpressure amplification rather than a single node failure.

Can Redwood trigger a regional taper/drain to shift inbound traffic to US-EAST while you investigate? We need minimal disruption but immediate relief. If a manual or priority reroute requires leadership approval, please escalate — we will need a timetable and any potential credit/mitigation ask for our customers.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Head of Platform Operations
Quasar Health

Attachments: quasar_incident_graph_071926.png, kvcache-stats-0719.csv

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Looping you all in — external P0 from Quasar Health. Key asks: (1) immediate traffic taper/drain plan for US-WEST -> US-EAST, (2) short customer comms and potential one-off credit, (3) exec sign-off window for priority pin/traffic steering and temporary elevated capacity.

Initial ask to SRE: can we do a progressive 75/25 split over 10 minutes (US-EAST taking 75%) and monitor KV cache hit-rate regression? Rishi, any foreseeable regression on session affinity if we shift at that ratio?

Vanessa/David — need recommended wording for comms and a quick estimate of cost/credit if we propose a 24-hour priority pin or cross-region burst.

I will try to get Anita on a 15-min bridge to agree cadence.

-LB

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Agree with progressive drain. Notes from infra:
- US-WEST KV cache warm-up will cause an initial uptick in latency for requests routed to US-EAST for first ~30s per session as cache warms.
- There's potential for duplicate token charges if clients retry aggressively; recommend setting a 409/429 guidance in the comms.
- Suggested plan: 10m ramp to 70/30 (EAST/WEST), monitor token-queue slope and 5xx; if slope improves by 50% in 15m continue to 90/10, then 100% drain if stable.
- We can enable an autoscale burst for Quasar but that requires approval for a temporary Dedicated capacity burst (cost estimate attached).

I’ll stand by for the bridge.

Rishi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@quasarhealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@quasarhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Anita / Tom — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. Proposed immediate action from Redwood:
1) Start progressive routing ramp now: 10 minutes -> target 70% traffic to US-EAST, 30% remain in US-WEST. (Rishi: please kick.)
2) We will monitor the KV cache warm-up and 5xx; if metrics improve per plan we will continue to 90/10 and then full drain.
3) If Quasar wants us to enable a temporary Dedicated burst for guaranteed capacity we need approval; that will be a billable/spend item and requires a short exec sign-off.
4) We'll prepare a short customer-facing note recommending clients silence aggressive retry on 5xx for the next hour and escalate to Redwood support for any sessions that remain impacted.

Can you confirm you are on the bridge at :15?

- Lauren

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, Anita Rao <anita.rao@quasarhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Bridge notes and escalation summary:
- 09:15 bridge (15m) with Quasar concluded: initial ramp to 70/30 started at 09:25 PT. KV cache warmed as expected; 95th latency for median sessions dropped from ~980ms -> ~260ms within 9 minutes. 5xx dropped from 6% -> 1.1% in that window.
- Quasar requested an exec-level ask: (A) approval to enable a 24-hour priority pin for guaranteed capacity while they run postmortem; (B) guidance on whether we can offer a goodwill credit for the 2 hour customer impact window.
- Cost estimate for the 24-hour burst (on Dedicated routing) if approved: ~$8,400. Projected token overage impact if we did not pin: variable — recommend pin if SLA-critical.

Proposed leadership ask text for approval (short):
"Approve a 24-hour Dedicated priority pin for Quasar Health for $8.4k to stabilize production while both teams investigate. Offer a one-time goodwill credit equivalent to one day's average token spend for impacted customers as compensation; finance to confirm final amount."

Marissa, David: will you please confirm finance/credit feasibility? I recommend a rapid yes/no so we can communicate to Quasar this afternoon.

-Vanessa

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai, Anita Rao <anita.rao@quasarhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quasar production: token queue spiral causing sustained 5xx + latency

Quick update from finance: we can approve a goodwill credit capped at the equivalent of 1 day's average Quasar token spend (est. $3,200) without CEO sign-off. Approval for the 24-hour Dedicated priority pin needs VP approval due to capacity commitments; I am looped in with the Capacity Planning team and can escalate immediately.

Immediate recommendation: authorize the 24-hour pin (VP-level) and commit the $3.2k goodwill credit to the customer; we will bill the Dedicated burst to a short-term cost center pending commercial reconciliation if leadership does not grant a longer-term concession.

If leadership wants a different cadence/message, please advise but I recommend we tell Quasar we will cover the goodwill credit now and request VP expedited sign-off for the pin.

-Marissa
